content_zh:
【阅前提示：非爽文，介意慎入】
……
景国，江州。
书院，主殿。
殿门站着数十名学子，人头攒动，眼神好奇地往里面张望。
“听说了吗？咱们书院的第一才子姜峰，竟然偷窃其他学子的银两，被人当场抓获，如今书院的杨博士正在里面公开审讯。”
“姜大才子偷人家银子？这不会吧！
他家里虽然穷，可应该不至于干出这种糊涂事吧？”
“怎么不可能，这都人赃并获了。”
“听说他父亲是个穷铁匠，呵呵，那种粗鄙之人培养出来的孩子，做出此等卑劣之事，也就不足为奇了。”
“听人说他还常常去酒仙楼喝花酒，怪不得有钱，原来钱都是偷来的。”
“所以说啊，这有些人表面看起来是正人君子，高风亮节，可背地里却是道貌岸然，藏着一肚子的阴暗龌龊，这种人就不应该继续留在江州书院，坏了咱们书院的名声。”
“不错，咱们书院向来注重品德，学子哪怕才气再高，可若是品行不端，就算学识再高，将来哪怕为官一任，那也是祸害一方百姓的贪官。”
“此等卑劣无耻之徒，真希望书院能速速将此人赶走，莫要污染了这神圣之地。”
……
殿内，姜峰一脸平静的站在那里，身上穿着一件洗的浆白的长袍，脚下是有些皲裂布鞋。
这一世，他生得剑眉星目，相貌俊朗。
如今这一身的穿着，确实配不上他的容颜。
至于身后学子的讨论声他自然都听到了，可内心既不惊讶，也无愤怒。
导致今天这个场面的原因有很多，有文人相轻，有人云亦云，有故意栽赃，可说来说去不外乎还是因为两个字：利益！

只要他姜峰还在学宫一天，这第一才子的名头就一天落在他的头上，对于其他学子来说，何时才有出头之日？
至于真相如何，他们并不关心。
哪怕你是被冤枉的，可在他们心中，你永远都不无辜。
冤枉你的人，比你还知道你有多冤枉。
两世为人，这些道理姜峰比任何人都懂。
没错，十年前，他的灵魂从蓝星穿越而来。
他只记得，上一世他下班时，路过一条斑马线，恰好见到一辆大卡车好似失控了一般，撞向一个即将过马路的小女孩，他想都没想，上前一把将小女孩推开，自己却被大卡车撞飞十几米远。
临死前，他隐约见到一扇巨大的门户，散发出强烈的光，可他当时还以为那是大卡车的车灯。
可等到重新醒来时，人已经穿越到这个世界，宿主当时还只是一个八岁的小男孩，有一个父亲，一个姨娘，一个异父异母的妹妹。
姜峰后来也翻过这个世界的历史典籍。
自万年前，燧朝崩，诸国立！
万年以来，神州大地上，曾出现过大大小小数百个国家，连年厮杀，战乱不休，大国吞并小国，小国依靠大国，到如今，整个神州仅剩下秦，武，景，炎，周，靖，蜀，楚，旸九大霸国。
景太祖千年前于东土立国，国祚经历了上千年，时至今日，景国依旧兵强马壮，繁荣昌盛，在神州大地有着盛景之称。
如今的景国文风盛行，国人皆以读书人为傲，地位尊崇。
千年以来，多少读书人经历寒窗苦读，最终金榜题名从而一夜成名的事迹，被编纂成各类话本，在民间广为流传。
姜峰凭借着上辈子的记忆，一不小心在江州混出一个‘第一才子’的名号，也因此造成了今日之事端。
砰！

…
Jingguo, Jiangzhou.
Academy, main hall.
Dozens of students stood at the gate of the palace, crowded, looking inside with curious eyes.
"Have you heard? Jiang Feng, the most talented person in our academy, actually stole money from other students and was caught red-handed. Dr. Yang from the academy is now interrogating him publicly."
"Jiang, a great talent, steals other people's money? This can't be done!"
Although his family is poor, he shouldn't do such stupid things, right? "
"How is it impossible? Everyone got the stolen goods."
"I heard that his father was a poor blacksmith. Haha, it's not surprising that a child raised by such a vulgar person would do such despicable things."
"I heard that he often goes to Jiuxian Tower to drink flower wine. No wonder he has money. It turns out that the money was stolen."
"So, some of these people appear to be gentlemen and upright on the surface, but secretly they are sanctimonious and hide a lot of darkness and filth. Such people should not continue to stay in Jiangzhou Academy and ruin the reputation of our academy."
"Yes, our academy has always paid attention to moral character. No matter how talented the students are, if they have bad conduct, no matter how knowledgeable they are, even if they serve as an official for one term in the future, they will be corrupt officials who harm the people."
"Such a despicable and shameless person, I really hope that the academy can expel this person quickly, so as not to pollute this sacred place."
…
In the hall, Jiang Feng stood there with a calm face, wearing a washed starched white robe and some cracked cloth shoes under his feet.
In this life, he was born with sword-like eyebrows and starry eyes, and was handsome in appearance.
The clothes he was wearing now really didn't match his appearance.
As for the discussion among the students behind him, he naturally heard it, but he was neither surprised nor angry inside.
There are many reasons leading to today's scene, some are scornful, some are following others' opinions, and some are deliberately framed, but it all boils down to two words: profit!
As long as Jiang Feng is still in the academy, the title of the most talented person will fall on his head. When will other students be able to succeed?
As for the truth, they don't care.
Even if you are wronged, you are never innocent in their hearts.
The person who wronged you knows better than you how wronged you are.
As a man of two generations, Jiang Feng understands these principles better than anyone else.
That's right, his soul traveled from Blue Star ten years ago.
He only remembered that in his last life, when he was getting off work, he passed a zebra crossing and happened to see a large truck that seemed to have lost control and hit a little girl who was about to cross the road. Without thinking, he stepped forward and pushed the little girl away, but he was hit by the big truck and flew more than ten meters away.
Before he died, he vaguely saw a huge door emitting a strong light, but at the time he thought it was the headlights of a large truck.
But when he woke up again, he had traveled to this world. The host was still an eight-year-old boy with a father, an aunt, and a half-sister.
Jiang Feng later also looked through the historical books of this world.
Since the Sui Dynasty collapsed thousands of years ago, all the countries have been established!
Over the past ten thousand years, hundreds of countries, large and small, have appeared on the land of China. They have been fighting for years and endless wars. Big countries have annexed small countries, and small countries have relied on big countries. Until now, there are only nine hegemonic countries left in the entire China: Qin, Wu, Jing, Yan, Zhou, Jing, Shu, Chu, and Yang.
Jing Taizu founded the country in the east a thousand years ago, and the country has experienced thousands of years. To this day, Jing State is still strong and prosperous, and is known as a grand scene in the land of China.
Today, the literary style of Jingguo is prevalent, and people in the country are proud of scholars and their status is respected.
Over the past millennium, the stories of how many scholars have endured hard study and eventually become famous overnight by being named on the gold medal list have been compiled into various storybooks and widely circulated among the people.
Relying on the memories of his previous life, Jiang Feng accidentally found a ‘number one talent’ in Jiangzhou.’ The name also caused today’s troubles.
Bang!
